'''''Rhododendron stenopetalum''''' is a [[rhododendron]] [[species]] native to southern [[Honshu]] and north-eastern [[Shikoku]], [[Japan]].<ref name=POWO_948101-1/> It has been placed in [[Rhododendron subg. Azaleastrum|subgenus ''Azaleastrum'']].<ref name=GRIN_470498>{{GRIN |mode=cs1 |name=''Rhododendron stenopetalum'' (Hogg) Mabb.  |id=470498 |access-date=2024-01-01}}</ref> It is a low [[shrub]], with leaves that are 3–5 mm wide by 5 cm long. Its flowers are pink or lavender-pink.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Rhododendron stenopetalum 'Linearifolium' {{!}} Landscape Plants {{!}} Oregon State University |url=https://landscapeplants.oregonstate.edu/plants/rhododendron-stenopetalum-linearifolium |access-date=2024-05-16 |website=landscapeplants.oregonstate.edu}}</ref>
